description.p: You have a +2 bonus to AC while wearing this armor (13 + your Dexterity modifier).
Veiled Step. When you roll initiative and at the start of each of your turns, the next attack made against you before the start of your next turn has disadvantage.
Shadow Vanish (3/Long Rest). You can cast invisibility without expending a spell slot. You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

sheet.description: Veiled Step: when you roll initiative and at the start of each of your turns, the next attack against you before your next turn has disadvantage. Shadow Vanish: cast invisibility without a spell slot.

description.p: While you wear this vest and no armor, your AC is 11 + your Dexterity modifier.
Adroit Weave. Your Dexterity score increases by 2, to a maximum of 22.
Master's Echo. Whenever an ally you are in combat with scores a critical hit, your next attack during your turn is a critical hit.

sheet.description: Master's Echo: when an ally in the fight scores a critical hit, your next attack on your turn is a critical hit.
